title.value: Produce a short-form video from research to captions

introduction.value: Hermes Agent researched a JWST topic, wrote the script, generated assets, built Remotion motion graphics, added voiceover, music and captions for a vertical video.

method.value: The author prompted Hermes Agent step by step. It searched the web and compared sources, then wrote a research document and recommended a topic. The author picked JWST finding methane on an interstellar comet. From that, the agent wrote a script and a scene-by-scene plan, generated artwork, and built Remotion components using installed Remotion skills. It checked rendered frames against the plan and revised scenes. It then added voiceover, music and effects, and Whisper-timed word-highlight captions.

outcome.value: The result is a rendered vertical video for Shorts, Reels or TikTok. The article gives no timings, costs or failure details, and shows the result mainly through a linked video walkthrough.

notes.value: Voiceover and image generation can use local or cloud providers, so choose these before you start. The article doesn't state costs or run time.

Produce a short-form video from research to captions
Hermes Agent researched a JWST topic, wrote the script, generated assets, built Remotion motion graphics, added voiceover, music and captions for a vertical video.
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
The author prompted Hermes Agent step by step. It searched the web and compared sources, then wrote a research document and recommended a topic. The author picked JWST finding methane on an interstellar comet. From that, the agent wrote a script and a scene-by-scene plan, generated artwork, and built Remotion components using installed Remotion skills. It checked rendered frames against the plan and revised scenes. It then added voiceover, music and effects, and Whisper-timed word-highlight captions.
How it went
The result is a rendered vertical video for Shorts, Reels or TikTok. The article gives no timings, costs or failure details, and shows the result mainly through a linked video walkthrough.
Worth knowing
Voiceover and image generation can use local or cloud providers, so choose these before you start. The article doesn't state costs or run time.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Make a vertical short-form video about [topic]. Research it using reliable sources, write a 45-second script, generate visuals, build motion graphics, add a voiceover, background music, and captions. Show me the script for approval before you generate assets, and finish by saving the video to [folder].
Original source: https://dev.to/vivek_shetye/build-an-end-to-end-ai-video-production-pipeline-with-hermes-agent-and-remotion-183i
